messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — night warmup & standby plan for the feature rollout tonight. Target start 00:30 UTC. US -> EU -> APAC sequence.

maria: Reason: predictable thermal/queue surface and avoid simultaneous warmups across geos. We'll keep EU pinned to v2.1.4 for 1h during verification.

ben: Ack. Can you confirm warm pool sizes + standby counts for each region? :thumbsup:

ana: (ana) current warm pool counts: US=48 GPUs (8 warm standby), EU=36 GPUs (6 warm standby), APAC=20 GPUs (4 warm standby). Overall spare headroom ~15% after allocation.

ben: Cool. For EU pin — does that mean pin requests to the older model on failure or pin the new version?

maria: Pin EU to v2.1.4 (previous stable) for 1h while canary traffic bakes. New version will be routed with canary slice only. If canary looks good, we lift pin and proceed. Rollback triggers documented below.

kai: Suggest staggering the warmups by 7 minutes between regions to smooth power draw and gpu scheduler pressure. US start 00:30, EU 00:37, APAC 00:44.

maria: Agree — plan updated. Deploy-bot will run staged start with those offsets.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: slice=night-warmup-2026-03-22, regions=[us,europe,apac], offsets=[0m,7m,14m], model=new-experiment:v3.0-canary, pin=europe:v2.1.4:60m. Job id=deploy-1798881234-1.

deploy-bot: Prechecks ok: image pulled on 95% of nodes, KV-cache priming assets available, autoscaler quotas OK.

maria: Rollback criteria (quick summary):
- immediate rollback if per-region error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m OR p99 latency increase >300ms over baseline for 5m.
- thermal/eviction trigger: if node preemption signs observed >2 nodes in 10m -> throttle and revert.
- unexpected model quality regression flagged by eval-signal -> immediate canary pause and notify.

ben: Add a manual holdpoint at EU pin lift — request ops signoff before unpin.

maria: Done. EU unpin requires signoff from @ben or @ana within the 1h window.

jamie: Drop release notes link here and the quick rollback playbook? I'll be on standby at 00:30–02:00 UTC.

maria: Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.0-night-warmup (short summary + perf diffs)
Rollback playbook gist:
```
# quick commands
deploybot cancel deploy-1798881234-1
deploybot pin region=eu version=v2.1.4
# fallback route
route update --service=inference --route=stable --target=model:v2.1.4
```

ana: I'll stream the capacity/thermal dashboard and post snapshots at each region start.

kai: :eyes: I'll watch queue length and scheduler logs, call out if we need to slow offsets.

ben: If EU sees p50 jump but p99 steady — hold unpin but don't rollback. We want to avoid noisy rollback on median.

maria: Agreed. Final checklist: deploy-bot job scheduled, offsets set, EU pin in place, signoff path = ben/ana, oncall jamie standby. Any objections?

kai: None from infra side.

deploy-bot: Starting canary slice at 00:30 UTC for us. Will post events to this thread.

maria: Thanks all — will post post-start snaps and the first 30m heatmap. :thumbsup:
